name: The Grain Rain (Cốc Vũ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Rain That Does Not Stop (Vũ Bất Tuyệt)
bonuses.rule: your healing rain stays on the field until you fall. For every 10 s it has fallen, it heals 10 % more and costs you 1 % of your health each second, and nothing reduces that cost.

story: The founder's banner and seed gourd and the abbess's own robe, worn together at every Grain Rain since 1000. She wore them nine days running in the drought of 1150, and her meridians have not been right since.
